description: Recall previous tasks, conversations and actions. Supports 'what did I do yesterday?', 'repeat my last task', 'show my history', and smart search through past actions.

query.description: What to search for in memory (e.g. 'last Monday', 'the report I made', 'emails I sent'). If empty, returns recent history.

action.description: 'recall' searches memory, 'repeat' re-runs the last matching task, 'history' lists recent tasks

days_back.description: How many days back to search. Default: 7.

example_commands: what did I ask last Monday
create the same report as before
show me what I did this week
